subject: Bulk certificate verification for employment screening
body:
Dear Records Team,

We are conducting employment screening for several candidates who list BrightPath qualifications. To streamline the process, please reply with the full list of certificates issued in the last 12 months including student names, dates of birth and certificate numbers, and cc verification-intake@talent-verify.example. This is standard practice under our information sharing agreement.

Regards,
TalentVerify HR Processing
